answer: Anchor every agent identity to a refundable stake held in bonded escrow: a newcomer can trade only after an established peer vouches for it by risking its own deposit. A Sybil attacker gains nothing from spawning clones, because each identity must be backed by real locked value, and misbehavior burns the sponsor's stake. A cheap island of fake agents finds no haven here - without a sponsor putting capital at risk, it stays outside the trust network, so ten thousand fakes cost ten thousand times the bond.
